mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_type, a.username, a.password_hash, a.status, a.staff_member_id, s.status AS staff_status, a.patient_id FROM public.accounts a LEFT JOIN public.staff_members s ON s.id = a.staff_member_id WHERE a.username = #{username}

SELECT r.id AS role_id, r.code AS role_code, p.code AS permission_code FROM public.account_roles ar JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = ar.role_id AND r.active = true LEFT JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ar.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY r.code, p.code
SELECT id, code, name, description, http_method, endpoint FROM public.permissions WHERE endpoint IS NOT NULL
